sourceText:
Halibut With Fennel
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 27, 2010 - 12:08am

Ingredients




3 tablespoons Unsalted butter
2 Shallots minced
(or 2 tbspns minced scallions)
1 Halibut steak, 1 inch thick - (2 lbs)
1 Fresh fennel bulb cut thin julienne
Juice of 2 lemons
Coarse kosher salt to taste
Freshly-ground black pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. 2 Butter a shallow baking dish. Sprinkle the shallots over the bottom and put the halibut steak on top. Arrange the fennel julienne over the fish, dot with the remaining butter, and sprinkle with the lemon juice and salt and pepper. 3 Bake for 10 minutes, remove from the oven, and baste fish with the cooking juices. Return to the oven and cook 10 minutes more, or until fish is done (the flesh should be white at the bone). Adjust seasoning and serve. 4 This recipe yields 4 servings.
